vb_textbox.text: there are 2 groups one high scoring one not, the 2 groups are yellow brown purple and green, the other group is red pinl orange and blue. you will be given one from each group eg one pink and one green. if you pick green and score 1 then that is the wrong group as the right group scores 5or more so pick a colour from the other group next. its quite hard to think about so quickly so just remember which colours score high. if that colour then starts to score low then change over to the other group. the groups stayed the same for a few rounds upto about 30 goes. dont spend too much time tho as you will be classed tooslow and wont score anything at all, its quite challenging but good fun and gets your brain working
